english.title: Intentionally do an act capable of encouraging / assisting the attempted suicide of another
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which was capable of encouraging or assisting the attempted suicide of **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(1) of the Suicide Act 1961.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally did an act which was capable of encouraging / assisting attempt suicide

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required to prosecute this offence.
(ii) Section 1A of the Suicide Act 1961 as amended by the Coroners and Justice Act 2009 provides that the person need not be a specific person or class of persons known to, or identified by the defendant.
(iii) Section 1B of the Suicide Act 1961 as amended by the Coroners and Justice Act 2009 provides that the defendant may commit this offence whether or not a suicide occurs.
(iv) Section 2A of the Suicide Act 1961 as amended by the Coroners and Justice Act 2009 provides examples of actions capable of encouraging or assisting suicide.
